messages:
Jordan (AE): Heads up: Nimbus Labs POC needs an onboarding runbook for hosted -> dedicated -> VPC migration. 2-week POC, EU data residency, likely embeddings later. Who can own?
Priya (SE): I can run it. Need model preference and expected qps. Also will prepare a short FAQ for procurement.
Jordan (AE): They're targeting ~60 rps peak, chat + embeddings. Prefer open checkpoint.
Ethan (Platform Eng): For hosted start, we can spin trial org + API key. For Dedicated later: recommend 1x8 GPU with autoscale to handle peaks. VPC requires infra intake; lead time ~10 business days.
Lina (Security): Requirements noted: SOC2, EU-only tenancy, KMS integration, minimal logs retention. I'll draft answers to the security questionnaire and list required exhibits.
Priya (SE): Draft runbook steps (concise):
- Step 1: Create trial org in EU and generate ephemeral API key
- Step 2: Share quickstart repo and cURL examples
- Step 3: Add rate-limits and billing cap to org
- Step 4: Collect contact for ops + security + approve data types
- Step 5: If Dedicated requested, open infra ticket and schedule sizing call
Ethan (Platform Eng): Internal CLI to create trial org:
```
# internal
rwctl org create --name "nimbus-poc" --region eu-west-1 --tier trial
rwctl api-keys create --org nimbus-poc --note "poc-ephemeral"
```
Priya (SE): I'll run a smoke test in eu-west-1 and send back logs. Also will include a cost estimate for 2 weeks with usage cap.
Jordan (AE): Procurement asks whether we can provide a short-term discount for POC usage and who they invoice. Add billing contact.
Ethan (Platform Eng): For POC discount, suggest a note: "POC usage billed at standard rates, with one-time credit if move to Dedicated within 30 days". For Dedicated commit, provide estimate and lead time.
infra-bot: ticket POC-VPC-123 created for Nimbus Labs by Ethan.
Priya (SE): I'll own the POC run and coordinate with Lina on the security responses. Jordan, I'll share the runbook with customer after validation.
Jordan (AE): Great, schedule kickoff with Nimbus tomorrow. :calendar:
